sources.fullCitation: Images Musicales. “Tot Weerziens, Mijnheer Jansen (Auf Wiederseh'n Herr Doktor!).” Dutch-language sheet-music cover. The cover reads “Hollandsche tekst van Ferry” and “Lied und Foxtrot von Fritz Rotter u. Dr. B. Kaper”; illustrator: Hassel; publisher: Wiener Boheme Verlag, Rechte Wienzeile 33, Wien; 4 pp.; publication no. W.B.V. 1328; 1929. Images Musicales catalogue metadata additionally parses music as Fritz Rotter and B. Kaper and lyrics as Fritz Rotter, B. Kaper, and Ferry. Source for W-S010 / S010, Title Variant TV0305, and Media M053.
